verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships a local dev server that executes tasks before deployment, and a dashboard run inspector for debugging runs, which a user praises for testing and iterating. Nothing documents supplying sample or pinned payloads, or inspecting each step's input and output. missing for 10: documented sample/pinned test payloads, per-step input/output inspection, in-depth first-party docs on a test workflow before going live.

support.subject: As a developer, I can test a workflow with sample or pinned data and inspect each step's input and output before going live

citations.quote: This runs a server on your machine that can execute Trigger.dev tasks
Quickly identify queued, errored or waiting tasks and debug them using the run inspector.
Also want to call out the Dev mode: it's an absolute gem, makes testing and iterating so much smoother than anything else I've tried.
